title: Banner blur and new checkboxes

items.title: Optional banner blur
items.text: Turn on “Blur my banner behind my profile” in your profile editor. Your banner is stretched, blurred and faded into your card theme.

items.title: New checkboxes
items.text: Every checkbox in Aduna now has the same rounded look, in your theme’s colors.

title: Behind-the-scenes improvements

items.title: Smoother update notes
items.text: Update notes are now prepared for every release, so What’s new stays complete and up to date.

title: Contexto is here

items.title: New minigame: Contexto
items.text: Open the + menu, pick Minigames, then Contexto. Guess the secret word of the day by meaning: every word you try gets a number, and the closer its meaning, the lower the number. 1 is the word itself.

items.title: Play on your own or with a server
items.text: Aduna has its own daily word, and every server gets one of its own with standings for its members. Use a hint if you are stuck, give up to see the word, and share your result into any chat.

title: Minigames feel faster

items.title: Faster first Wordle guess
items.text: Wordle’s word list is now ready before you play, so your first guess no longer takes a moment to check.

items.title: Contexto keeps your cursor
items.text: After you press Enter on a guess in Contexto, you can keep typing without clicking the box again.

title: Tag channels, to-do lists and goals

items.title: Tag a channel with #
items.text: Type # in a server chat and pick a channel. It shows as a chip in the message, and clicking it takes you straight to that channel. It keeps working if the channel is renamed.

items.title: To-do channels
items.text: A new channel type for a shared task list. Owners choose which roles can add tasks, tasks can be given to a role, and the people holding that role can tick them off.

items.title: Goals channels
items.text: A new channel type where the owner sets goals with progress bars or checkboxes, and everyone in the server can follow how they are going.

items.title: Server templates
items.text: Start a new server from a ready-made template with channels and roles already set up, for example a business or a community.

title: Webhooks, smarter bots and a name checker

items.title: Server webhooks
items.text: Server managers can create a secret web address that other services post to. A webhook can drop a message in a text channel or hand its data to one of the server's bots. There is a generic JSON kind and a GitHub kind for push events.

items.title: Bots hear webhooks
items.text: Bots can now react to data that arrives through a webhook of their server, so a bot can post build results or alerts in its own words.

items.title: Bots see reactions
items.text: Bots can now react when someone adds a reaction to a message, in addition to messages, joins, leaves and timers.

items.title: Name checker
items.text: Usernames, display names, bios and server names are checked. If one is not appropriate you get a warning in the app and 3 days from the moment you see it to change it.

items.title: Themes tab in Explorer
items.text: Explorer has a new Themes tab for browsing themes.

title: Bot pages and longer messages

items.title: Pictures and banners for bots
items.text: Bot developers can now give a bot a picture and a wide banner in Settings > Developer. The banner shows on the bot’s page and on its profile.

items.title: Long description for bots
items.text: A bot can have a longer description of up to 1,500 characters, with line breaks, to explain what it does and how to use it.

items.title: Bot pages in Explorer
items.text: On the Bots tab, bots now show their banner and picture. Press Read more, or a bot’s name, to open its page and add it to a server.

items.title: Longer messages with Aduna Plus
items.text: Aduna Plus members can write messages up to 4,000 characters instead of 2,000. A counter appears in the message box as you get close to the limit.

title: Zoom while you share your screen

items.title: Zoom in on your cursor
items.text: In the Aduna desktop app, while you share your whole screen, press Ctrl + Alt + Shift + Z to zoom the shared picture in on your cursor. Press it again to zoom back out. Scroll while zoomed in to zoom even closer. You still see your normal screen; only the people watching see the zoom.

items.title: Pick your own shortcut
items.text: Don’t like the shortcut? Change it in Settings > Voice & Video. It has to include Ctrl, Alt or Win so normal typing is never affected.

title: A clearer checkout

items.title: Clearer checkout
items.text: The checkout now says plainly that payments are handled securely by PayPal and that your card details go straight to PayPal, never to Aduna. Where sales tax applies, you can type your postal or ZIP code to find your tax region; the code itself stays in your browser.

title: A clearer Storage window

items.title: Storage window tidy-up
items.text: The upload-limit choices for Aduna Plus now look right: normal capital letters, even spacing and proper radio buttons. The number box sits inside the “Set an upload limit” choice, and Save only turns on once you change something.

items.title: A bar you can read
items.text: The storage bar no longer looks empty on dark themes, and a small amount of use still shows a sliver. Under it you now see how much you have used and how much is free, or your upload limit if you set one.

items.title: Member goal on the home page
items.text: The Aduna home page now shows how many people have joined and how close we are to our goal of 1,000 members.

title: Unsafe links and moderator warnings

items.title: Unsafe links are hidden
items.text: Links that look dangerous, such as lookalike addresses, link shorteners and program downloads, now show as “Link hidden: looks unsafe”. Press “Show anyway” to see the real address first and decide for yourself. This also works in direct messages and group chats.

items.title: Known bad sites are blocked
items.text: Addresses on Aduna’s block list can’t be opened from a message at all. Creators can add to the list from the admin page and the change shows up right away.

items.title: Warnings from moderators
items.text: If a moderator warns you, you see it when you open Aduna and have to press “I understand” before you can send messages again. Warnings count for 90 days. The third is a 24-hour mute and the fifth is a 7-day suspension.

title: Pay for storage with a saved card

items.title: Card on file for the storage plan
items.text: You can now pay for the Aduna Plus storage plan with a card that PayPal keeps for you. It renews once a month, and you can cancel it any time in the Storage window. Aduna never sees your card number.

items.title: Easier card form
items.text: The card form in checkout has bigger fields and no extra border inside the box, and it highlights the field you are typing in. This applies to the storage plan and to buying credits.

title: New credit packs and prices in Canadian dollars

items.title: New credit packs
items.text: Credits now come in four packs: 500, 1,350, 2,900 and 6,200. The bigger the pack, the more extra credits you get for your money.

items.title: Pay in Canadian or US dollars
items.text: Pick your country and province or state at checkout. People in Canada see prices and pay in Canadian dollars, and people in the US pay in US dollars. The price you see already includes PayPal's fee, so checkout shows one price.

items.title: Canada and the US only for now
items.text: Credits and the Aduna Plus storage plan can only be bought from Canada or the US at the moment. Storage is now $7.69 a month in Canadian dollars, and the US price follows the exchange rate.

title: Credit packs and prices changed

items.title: New pack sizes
items.text: Credits now come in packs of 500, 1,000, 2,500 and 5,000. They cost $2.49, $3.99, $7.69 and $10.89 in Canadian dollars. The US price follows the exchange rate.

title: Card form fix for US checkout

items.title: Card form after switching country
items.text: Switching between Canada and the US at checkout could leave the card form stuck on an error. The card boxes now load for either country.

title: Back button on phones and a voice bar above storage

items.title: Back works on phones
items.text: On a phone, Back now closes a window first, then the member list, then the chat, which takes you to the channel list. It no longer closes the app.

items.title: Voice bar above storage
items.text: While you are in a voice channel, a Voice Connected bar sits above the storage bar in the sidebar. Press it to go back to the channel, or press the phone button to leave. On phones the floating chip only shows while the sidebar is hidden.

items.title: Attachments stay until space runs out
items.text: Attachments are no longer deleted after a set number of days. They only go when space is needed: the oldest files of people without Aduna Plus make room for new uploads.

items.title: Creators can message anyone
items.text: Creator accounts can now start a direct message with people who are not their friends. The other person can reply once a creator has written first.

items.title: Reconnect notice fixed
items.text: The offline and reconnecting notice is now centered, and its Retry button stays inside the notice.

title: Aduna Plus card, lower price and more credits

items.title: Aduna Plus card
items.text: The Storage window and the bottom of the Shop now show everything Aduna Plus includes, with the price and a button to get it or manage your plan.

items.title: Lower price
items.text: Aduna Plus is now $5.59 a month in Canadian dollars, down from $7.69. The US price follows the exchange rate.

items.title: More credits with Plus
items.text: Plus members earn 1.5x the credits from quests. Messages pay 3 credits each for your first 60 a day, then 1 credit each until midnight UTC, with no daily cap.

items.title: Plus-only quests
items.text: Three new quests are for Plus members: Keep it going, Spread the love and A week of Plus. Everyone can see them, but only Plus members can claim them.

title: Plainer loading screen and Aduna Plus polish

items.title: Simpler loading screen
items.text: The loading screen now shows just the Aduna logo and name. The rings and the progress bar are gone.

items.title: Checkout says Aduna Plus
items.text: Checkout and PayPal now call the monthly plan Aduna Plus instead of Aduna Storage.

items.title: Sharper Plus logo
items.text: The Aduna Plus logo on the Plus card is cleaner, and it uses a brighter color on dark themes.

items.title: Clearer Plus perks
items.text: The list of what Aduna Plus includes is reworded to be shorter and easier to read.

title: Email is optional at sign-up, two accounts per device

items.title: Sign up without an email
items.text: You can now make an account without giving an email. If you skip it, email recovery is not available, and the sign-up page says so. Your recovery key is then the only way back in if you forget your password.

items.title: Two accounts per device
items.text: A browser can now make up to two accounts. If you try for a third, sign-up asks you to log in to one you already have. Deleting an account frees up a spot.

title: Email marked optional on sign-up

items.title: Optional tag on the email box
items.text: The email box on the sign-up page now has an Optional tag next to its label, so it is clear you can skip it.

title: Email label says (optional)

items.title: Plainer optional label
items.text: On the sign-up page the email label now reads "Email (optional)" in plain text instead of a badge.

title: Server tags, a picture check and admin tools

items.title: Server tags
items.text: Server owners can design a 4-character tag in Server settings > Server tag. Members of that server can choose to wear it next to their name from their profile editor. It shows in chat, the member list and on profile cards.

items.title: Explicit pictures are hidden
items.text: Pictures and videos are checked on your device before they are shown. Ones that look explicit are hidden, and ones that look suggestive are blurred until you click them. Explicit pictures can no longer be sent, or used as a profile picture, banner, emoji, sticker or badge. If you see a message to reload Aduna, do that once to get the update.

items.title: Filter people by role
items.text: Admins can now filter the People tab by artists, admins or founders, and artists have an Artist tag.

items.title: Remove an artist
items.text: Admins can take the artist role away from someone and give a reason. Their badge goes and their items come off sale, but people who already bought an item keep it. They can apply again after the usual wait.

title: Remove shop items from the admin page

items.title: Shop tab for admins
items.text: The admin page has a new Shop tab that lists every item for sale. An admin can remove one, which takes it off sale. People who already own it keep it.

items.title: Shop is view-only
items.text: The Pin, Daily shop, Edit and Take off sale buttons are gone from the shop itself.

title: Aduna has a new address

items.title: New web address
items.text: Aduna is now at aduna.dpdns.org, and the web app is at aduna.dpdns.org/app. The old aduna.onrender.com address is no longer used.

items.title: Update the desktop and Android apps
items.text: The new desktop and Android versions open the new address. Older versions still point at the old one, so install the new version to keep using the app.

items.title: Links to the new address work
items.text: Invite links and links to Aduna that use the new address are now recognized as Aduna links inside the app.

title: Moderators, server automod and bot commands

items.title: Moderator role
items.text: Admins can make someone a moderator on the admin page. A moderator can open the page, read every report and dismiss or restore what was reported. They can't warn, mute, suspend, delete or remove anything, and they don't see the other tabs.

items.title: Automod for servers
items.text: Server managers can turn on automod in the server settings. It can block banned words, links, invites, too many capitals, mention floods and repeated messages. Each rule either just refuses the message or adds a strike, and strikes can lead to a timeout or a kick. Roles and channels can be left out.

items.title: Bot commands in the message box
items.text: Type a bot's prefix, usually /, at the start of a message to see the commands of the bots in that server. Pick one to put it in the message box.

items.title: AI bot builder removed
items.text: The “Build with AI on this PC” panel is gone from the bot editor in the desktop app.

title: A waiting screen when the server is down

items.title: Waiting for the server
items.text: If Aduna can’t reach its server, the desktop and Android apps now show a “Waiting for the Aduna server” screen instead of a browser error. It checks every few seconds, opens Aduna by itself when the server is back, and has a Try now button.

items.title: Offline notice
items.text: If your device has no internet, the same screen says so.

title: Server tags are for public servers

items.title: Server tags need a public server
items.text: Only public servers can have a server tag that members wear. If a server goes private, the tag it made is kept but stops showing, and it comes back when the server is made public again. The Server tag tab explains this to owners.

items.title: Tags are checked for bad words
items.text: Server tags go through the same name check as everything else, plus a list of short forms that slip past a normal word list. A tag that is not allowed can’t be saved, and one that was already saved stops showing.

items.title: “cp” is blocked in names
items.text: “cp” is now on the blocked list for usernames, display names and server names, when it stands alone.

title: Profile frames can cover the picture

items.title: Art over the profile picture
items.text: A profile frame no longer has to leave the middle empty. Artists can draw inside the profile picture area too, and it shows over the picture.

items.title: Remove the background
items.text: When an artist picks a picture for a frame, Aduna asks if the plain background should be removed. A picture that is already see-through is left as it is.

items.title: Sample picture in the position window
items.text: The window where you move and zoom a frame now has a sample profile picture under the art, so you can see how it fits. You can turn it off.

items.title: Add the picture before you create the frame
items.text: In Settings > Artist, a new frame can get its picture before you press Create. It uploads as soon as the frame is made.

title: Moderators can warn and mute

items.title: Warn and mute
items.text: Moderators can now warn people and mute them for up to a day, on top of reviewing reports. Suspending, deleting and removing things for good stay with admins.

items.title: People tab for moderators
items.text: Moderators can search for someone and open a short profile with their reports, warnings and mute. They can’t see servers, clips, bots or storage details.

items.title: Limits on what they can undo
items.text: A moderator can only take back warnings they gave and lift mutes they set. They can’t act on admins or other moderators, and the warning that would suspend someone is left to an admin.

title: Releases tab fixes

items.title: Feature checklist fixed
items.text: In /admin > Releases, the feature checkboxes in Edit notes showed up as long empty bars with the names pushed to the side. They are normal checkboxes again.

items.title: Test works on any release
items.text: Test no longer needs features ticked first, and it is available on published releases too, not only drafts. With no features ticked you just get what is already live.

title: Moderator badge

items.title: Moderator badge
items.text: Moderators now wear a blue shield badge next to their name. It shows up when an admin makes someone a moderator and goes away when they are removed. Like other badges, it can be hidden in Settings > Profile.

title: Payments now go through Stripe

items.title: Stripe checkout
items.text: Credits and Aduna Plus are now paid for through Stripe instead of PayPal. You enter your card on Stripe’s page, and Aduna never sees it.

items.title: Billing button for Plus
items.text: Aduna Plus members get a Billing button in Storage and on the Payments page. It opens Stripe’s page where you can change your card or cancel.

items.title: Card surcharge line
items.text: Where a card processing surcharge applies, checkout lists it as its own line and includes it in the total before you pay.

items.title: Verified bots
items.text: Public bots now show a Verified label once an admin has reviewed their code. Bots that haven’t been reviewed show a warning, and you are asked to confirm before adding one to a server.

title: Move, scale and rotate profile frames

items.title: See the whole picture
items.text: The window where you position a frame now shows a bit more around the frame. The part outside the frame is dimmed, because that part gets cut off.

items.title: Position, scale and rotation
items.text: You can type exact values for the position, scale and rotation of the picture, or use the sliders. Rotation goes from -180 to 180 degrees, and the [ and ] keys turn it a step at a time. The saved frame matches what you see.

title: Stripe's own checkout page

items.title: Pay on Stripe's page
items.text: Buy credits and Aduna Plus now opens Stripe's checkout straight away. Stripe asks for your billing address there and adds the sales tax for it, so Aduna's own checkout screen and its postal code and location boxes are gone.

items.title: No card surcharge line
items.text: Checkout no longer adds a separate card processing surcharge. You pay the price plus the tax Stripe shows.

items.title: Frames show your picture
items.text: In the shop, profile frames are previewed on your own profile picture instead of a letter.

items.title: Admin shop items skip review
items.text: Items made by admin accounts go straight into the shop instead of waiting for a review that the admin could not give to their own work.

title: Profile editor crash fixed

items.title: Profile editor opens again
items.text: If you owned a profile frame, opening the profile editor showed a "Something went wrong" screen. It opens normally now.

title: Choosing a frame no longer crashes

items.title: Frame choice works
items.text: Picking a frame in the profile editor showed a "Something went wrong" screen. The frame now shows on your profile card preview as you pick it.

title: Frames keep the whole picture

items.title: Nothing is cut off
items.text: When an artist positions a frame, everything in the window is now kept, not only what sits inside the outlined square. Art that sticks out, like a hat, shows in full.

items.title: Existing frames stay as they are
items.text: Frames that are already in the shop keep their old shape. A new frame, or a draft that is uploaded again, uses the bigger area.

title: Frame window zooms out for big art

items.title: The window grows with your art
items.text: When you move or scale a frame picture past the edge of the window, the window now zooms out by itself, so you always see the whole picture and all of it is saved.

items.title: Bigger limit
items.text: A frame can now be up to five times as wide as the template square, up from three. Frames already in the shop are not changed.

title: Same name on shop items

items.title: Items can share a name
items.text: Two shop items, badges, frames or sticker packs can now have the same name. A few names stay reserved, like Creator and Artist.

title: Report a message

items.title: Report message
items.text: Right-click a message in a server channel (or tap More, or long-press on a phone) and pick Report message. Moderators see the message and your reason. The person who wrote it is not told who reported. Messages in DMs and group chats cannot be reported yet.

title: Credit prices include card fees

items.title: New credit pack prices
items.text: Credit packs now cost $2.39, $3.99, $7.59 and $10.69 in Canadian dollars, and $1.99, $2.99, $5.69 and $7.99 in US dollars. The card processing fee is part of the price, so checkout shows one price and no extra fee line.

items.title: Report window layout
items.text: The reasons in the Report window now line up, with normal capital letters and proper radio buttons.

title: Safer log out and uploads

items.title: Log out ends the session
items.text: Logging out now ends that login on the server too. Before, a copy of your session could still be used for up to 30 days. Sessions from before this update can only be ended with Log out everywhere.

items.title: Invite lookups are limited
items.text: Looking up invite codes is limited to 30 per connection every 15 minutes, so codes cannot be guessed one by one.

items.title: Cleaner uploaded pictures
items.text: Anything hidden after the end of a PNG, JPEG or WebP is now removed when you upload a picture, and old pictures are served without it.

items.title: Game search
items.text: Searching for a game shows no results instead of an error when Steam refuses the search. If Steam is busy it asks you to try again in a minute.

title: Type :emoji: names, and developer themes

items.title: Type an emoji by name
items.text: Write :sob: or :smile: in a message and it turns into the emoji when you send it. The message box suggests matches from two letters on, and it works when you edit a message too. Custom emoji with the same name still win.

items.title: Search the picker by name
items.text: The emoji picker also finds emoji by those same names, so :sob finds the crying face.

items.title: Emoji look the same everywhere
items.text: Aduna now brings its own emoji font on browsers that can use it. Newer emoji no longer show up as separate broken pieces on older systems.

items.title: Developer themes
items.text: Developers can write a theme as CSS with their own pictures under Settings > Developer, and preview it before sending it in. Nobody else can use it until an admin has read the CSS, looked at the pictures and verified it. Verified themes show up in the Themes tab in Explorer.

title: Bigger developer theme cards and a whole-site preview

items.title: Bigger theme cards
items.text: Developer themes in the Explorer now show as large cards, the same size as server cards, with a wide preview and the full description.

items.title: Save and apply
items.text: Each developer theme card has a Save and apply button. It saves the theme on this device and applies it. It reads Applied once it is on. Try still shows it without saving.

items.title: Preview on the whole site
items.text: When you write a developer theme, Preview on the whole site closes Settings so you can look at the real app with your theme on. A bar at the bottom lets you go back to the editor or stop the preview. Nothing is saved.

title: One Themes page, and scrolling fixes

items.title: All themes in one list
items.text: Colour themes and developer themes now sit together in one grid in the Explorer, all at the server card size. A Sort by menu offers Most used, Newest, A to Z, Z to A, and Custom or Colour themes first. The Light and dark filter is gone.

items.title: Colour themes turn off developer themes
items.text: Applying a colour theme now switches off the developer theme you were using, so its CSS no longer covers the new colours.

items.title: No more page scrolling
items.text: The app page no longer scrolls up, down or sideways behind the chat, which happened on some phones and browsers.

items.title: Many badges
items.text: A long row of badges next to a name now wraps instead of stretching the screen sideways.

title: Theme cards drawn in their own style

items.title: Cards use the theme's colours
items.text: In the Explorer, each theme card is now drawn in that theme's own colours: its background, text, borders and buttons.

items.title: Developer themes keep their font and corners
items.text: A developer theme's card also uses the font and the rounded or square corners that theme sets, when it sets them.

title: Theme cards use the theme's buttons

items.title: Save and apply and Try in the theme's button style
items.text: On a developer theme's card in the Explorer, the two buttons now look like that theme's own buttons: its fills, borders, text and shadows. A theme that does not style buttons keeps the normal look.

title: Layout editor for creator accounts

items.title: Move parts of the app around
items.text: In Settings > Appearance > Layout, creator accounts can put the server bar, side list, member list, profile and voice, Shortcuts and Unread in the top, left, right or bottom slot, in any order, or hide them. There are presets and a map to tap. It is saved per device and only works on wide windows, at least 1051 px across.

items.title: Creator accounts only for now
items.text: Everyone else keeps the standard layout and does not see the Layout section yet.

title: Drag to arrange the layout

items.title: Drag and drop
items.text: In Settings > Appearance > Layout, creator accounts now drag a part to where it should go, and a bar shows where it will land. Drag a part into Hidden to turn it off and back out to bring it in. With a part focused, the arrow keys move it within its slot.

items.title: A map that looks like the app
items.text: The map now draws the server bar thin, the lists wide and the other bars short, in the same order as the real layout.

items.title: Fixed a crash on open
items.text: The first layout update could show a "placeOf is not defined" error when Aduna opened. That is fixed.

title: Server bar drag fixes and layout on every side

items.title: Server bar drag and drop
items.text: Reordering servers and making folders works on all four bar positions. Dropping in a gap or past the last server now counts, a copy of the button follows the pointer, and Escape cancels. Dragging a server out of an open folder onto the back button takes it out.

items.title: Touch dragging
items.text: On a touch screen, press and hold a server, then drag. A normal swipe still scrolls the bar, and a long press on a folder opens its edit dialog.

items.title: Folders sync across devices
items.text: The order and folders of the server bar are saved to your account, so every device shows the same bar.

items.title: Layout works in every slot
items.text: In Settings > Appearance > Layout, the side list, member list, profile and voice, Shortcuts and Unread now fit properly on the top and bottom as well as the left and right. On the top or bottom they become a slim bar that scrolls sideways.

title: Layout editor for everyone

items.title: Move the server bar and the lists
items.text: In Settings > Appearance > Layout, everyone can now put the server bar, side list, member list, profile and voice, Shortcuts and Unread on the top, bottom, left or right, or hide them. It is saved per device and only works on windows at least 1051 px across.

items.title: Side list on the top or bottom
items.text: The side list and member list become a slim bar that scrolls sideways. There is a new preset, Side list on the bottom, and the layout map now draws these bars the way they look in the app.

title: Layout editor position list and strip fixes

items.title: Pick a position from a list
items.text: In Settings > Appearance > Layout, every part now has a Top, Left, Right, Bottom and Hidden choice under the map, for when dragging is awkward.

items.title: Bars that scroll sideways
items.text: On the top or bottom, the side list, member list, Shortcuts and Unread fade at an edge when there is more past it, and the mouse wheel scrolls them sideways. Switching channel scrolls the new one into view.

items.title: More room for channels
items.text: In a top or bottom side list, the voice, storage and profile blocks take less space on narrower windows, so more channels fit.

items.title: Server bar on the left or right
items.text: Hover tips open beside the button instead of covering the next server, and the list fades at the top or bottom when there are more servers.

items.title: Layout changes apply
items.text: The browser could block the style the layout editor writes, so a custom layout was sometimes ignored. It now applies.

items.title: Direct messages header
items.text: In a top or bottom side list on a narrow window, the plus button overlapped Explorer. It now has its own space.

title: Share a bar or column in the layout editor

items.title: Parts can share space
items.text: In Settings > Appearance > Layout, drop a part on another part to put them in the same bar or column. In a bar they sit side by side, in a column they are stacked. Drop a part between two bars or columns to give it one of its own.

items.title: Resize with a divider
items.text: Where parts share space, drag the divider between them to change their sizes. Double-click it to even them out, or focus it and use the arrow keys.

items.title: Two new presets
items.text: Server bar and shortcuts together, and Members and unread together.

items.title: Position list removed
items.text: The Top, Left, Right, Bottom and Hidden buttons under the map are gone. Drag a part, or focus it and use the arrow keys. Saved layouts keep working.

title: Layout editor for moderators and up

items.title: Layout is limited again
items.text: Settings > Appearance > Layout is now only for moderators, admins and creator accounts. Everyone else uses the standard layout, and a layout saved on their device is not applied. If you are made a moderator, your saved layout comes back.

title: Customize each part of the layout

items.title: Double-click a part
items.text: Double-click an empty spot of the server bar, side list, member list, profile and voice, Shortcuts or Unread (or double-click its box in Settings > Appearance > Layout) to customize it: where it sits, whether its things line up left, centre or right, and which of them show.

items.title: Turn things on and off
items.text: Every part has switches: the server bar (messages, clips, create a server, jump to), the side list (Lounge, Events, Friends, Explorer, Shop, Quests, the voice and storage bars), the member list (search, role headings), profile and voice (mute and deafen, credits, emoji, settings) and Unread (channels, group chats, messages).

items.title: More in Shortcuts
items.text: Shortcuts can now also show Direct messages, Quests, Clips, Custom emoji, Your profile and Create or join a server. They are off until you switch them on.

title: More ways to customize Shortcuts

items.title: Spacing, text and icons
items.text: In the Shortcuts customize dialog, a slider sets the space between buttons, and you can show each button with its text, its icon or both. At least one of the two stays on.

items.title: Put Shortcuts in your own order
items.text: Drag the shortcuts into the order you want, or select one and use the left and right arrow keys. Ones that are switched off stay in the row, dimmed, so they come back where you left them.

items.title: Settings is always within reach
items.text: The layout editor no longer lets you hide the last Settings button. If a saved layout has none, Settings is put back in Profile and voice. Shortcut buttons also show their name when you hover over them.

title: Light or dark for each part of the layout

items.title: Light or dark per part
items.text: Double-click a part of the layout and pick Match theme, Light or Dark under Colours. The part uses that look whatever theme the rest of Aduna has, and follows your theme again if you pick Match theme.

items.title: Matching shades in a top or bottom bar
items.text: Shortcuts in a top or bottom bar next to Profile and voice looked lighter than Profile and voice on dark themes. They now share the same background.

title: The layout works on phones

items.title: Arrange Aduna on your phone
items.text: In Settings > Appearance > Layout on a phone, tap a part to put it on the top, bottom, left or right, make it light or dark, or hide it. This works for the server bar, Profile and voice, Shortcuts and Unread, and it is kept on that phone.

items.title: Server bar on the side
items.text: A server bar on the left or right only shows on the Direct messages screen, not inside a chat or a server's channels. The side list and member list stay as they are on a phone.

items.title: Hidden in Customize
items.text: The Customize dialog now has a Hidden choice under Place it, so a part can be hidden without dragging it.

title: Server boosts

items.title: Boost a server with credits
items.text: Open the server menu and pick Boost server. Level 1 costs 1000 credits, level 2 costs 2000 and level 3 costs 3000. A boost lasts 14 days, and the server runs at the highest level that is active.

items.title: What each level gives
items.text: Level 1 ranks the server higher in Explore and gives the booster a Booster tag in that server. Level 2 allows 1080p, 60 fps screen sharing for everyone in its voice channels. Level 3 pays 1.5x credits for messages sent in the server.

items.title: Upgrades and refunds
items.text: You can have one boost per server. Upgrading replaces your own boost at the full price of the new level. If a server is deleted, each running boost gives its unused time back as credits.

title: Spin the wheel

items.title: Spin the wheel in a channel
items.text: In a text or announcements channel, open the + menu and pick Spin the wheel. Give it a title, one option per line, and the time it should spin. The server picks the winner at that time, so nobody knows it beforehand.

items.title: Everyone sees the same spin
items.text: If the channel is open when the time comes, you watch the wheel spin and the winner shows once it stops. Anyone who opens the channel later sees the wheel already stopped on the same spot.

items.title: Limits
items.text: A wheel needs at least 2 options and can have up to 500. The spin time can be up to 30 days ahead.

title: Boosted servers stand out

items.title: Boosted servers in Explorer
items.text: Boosted servers now sit at the top of the Servers tab in their own Boosted servers section. The rest are listed under All servers.

items.title: BOOSTED tag and purple stroke
items.text: A boosted server shows a purple BOOSTED tag next to its name in the side list and on invite and Explorer cards. Its icon in the server bar and its cards get a purple gradient stroke.

items.title: Booster tag in the member list
items.text: People who are boosting a server now have a Booster tag next to their name in the member list, as well as in chat.

title: New emoji look, big emoji and a free monthly boost

items.title: New emoji pictures
items.text: Emoji in messages, reactions, the emoji picker and the :name: suggestions now use the Fluent 3D set, so they look the same on every device. If a picture is missing for one, the normal emoji shows instead.

items.title: Big emoji
items.text: A message with only emoji, up to five, shows them large. Add any text or a sixth emoji and they go back to normal size.

items.title: Free boost with Aduna Plus
items.text: Aduna Plus members get one free level 3 server boost every month, on any server they are in. It lasts 14 days, replaces your own lower boost on that server, and the boost screen shows when your next one is ready.

title: Tossface emoji

items.title: Tossface emoji
items.text: Emoji in messages, reactions, the emoji picker and the :name: suggestions now use the Tossface set instead of the Fluent set from the last update. Emoji that Tossface does not have yet show as the normal emoji.

items.title: Emoji pictures load as small files
items.text: The pictures are no longer packed into one large script, which should help the emoji picker open faster on slow connections.

title: New video player and emoji fixes

items.title: New video player
items.text: Videos in chats have bigger buttons, a seek bar with a handle that is easy to grab, the time, download and fullscreen. The controls fade out while a video plays and come back when you touch or move the mouse over it. The player takes the shape of the video.

items.title: Fullscreen in the desktop app
items.text: The fullscreen button now fills the whole desktop window, not just the chat area. This needs desktop 1.4.118.

items.title: Emoji fixes
items.text: Emoji pictures still show if the emoji list fails to load, and one emoji that fails no longer turns other emoji in the same place into plain text. The emoji picker no longer hides some multi-part emoji.

title: Smaller video players

items.title: Smaller video players
items.text: Videos in chats are now at most 480 pixels wide and 360 pixels tall, with smaller buttons and a thinner control bar. Tall phone recordings no longer fill the whole chat.

title: Server notices in the app

items.title: Server notices at the top
items.text: When the team posts a notice about a restart, maintenance or a crash, it now shows as a banner at the top of the app, with the time the server should be back when there is one.

items.title: One banner for connection problems
items.text: Offline, reconnecting and back online now use the same banner. If a notice is up, the connection message sits under it.

title: Terms of Service and smoother typing

items.title: Terms of Service
items.text: Aduna now has its Terms of Service at aduna.dpdns.org/terms. There is a link to it at the bottom of the home page.

items.title: Smoother typing in busy chats
items.text: Typing in a long chat no longer redraws every message on each keystroke, so the message box keeps up.

items.title: Server notices are kept
items.text: Notices posted by the team are now stored in the database and are still there after a restart. A copy is also saved on the status site so it can show while the server is off.

title: Footer links on the public pages

items.title: Footer on the home, download and terms pages
items.text: These pages now share a footer with links to Home, Open Aduna, Download, the Terms of Service, the source code and where to report a problem.

title: Terms no longer name a person

items.title: Terms wording
items.text: The Terms of Service now say Aduna is run by one person instead of naming them. The license and README credit Aduna.

title: Agree to the Terms of Service

items.title: Two boxes at sign-up
items.text: The last step of sign-up now asks you to agree to the Terms of Service, with a link to read them, and to say you are 13 or older. You need both to make an account.

items.title: Agree again when the terms change
items.text: When you open Aduna after the Terms of Service have been updated, you see a screen asking you to agree to them. Everyone sees it once for the current terms. If you don't agree, you can log out.

title: Chess puzzles

items.title: Daily chess puzzle
items.text: Minigames now has a chess puzzle: find the checkmate in 1, 2 or 3 moves. There is one puzzle a day for everyone on Aduna and one for each server, with standings for its members. You get three wrong moves, and a daily streak counts the days in a row you solve it. Share your result into a chat.

items.title: Practice
items.text: Practice gives you as many puzzles as you like. Pick mate in 1, 2 or 3, and a fresh puzzle is made each time. Sometimes you play Black.

title: Chess board fixes

items.title: Even squares
items.text: Rows on the chess puzzle board no longer grow or shrink depending on which pieces are on them. All 64 squares are the same size.

items.title: New pieces
items.text: The chess pieces are now drawn as clean flat icons, white and black, so they look the same on every phone and browser. The promotion picker uses them too.

title: Chess puzzle levels and a bigger board

items.title: Easy, Medium and Hard
items.text: Practice has a second row of buttons next to Mate in 1, 2 and 3. Easy puzzles have fewer pieces and a king near the edge, hard ones have more pieces and a king in the open. The two rows work together, so you can play a hard mate in 1 or an easy mate in 3. The daily puzzle is unchanged.

items.title: Bigger board
items.text: The chess puzzle window is wider and the board is larger on desktop.

items.title: Clearer moves
items.text: Picking a piece now shows a small dot on each square it can go to. Squares where it can capture get shaded corners, and the pieces are no longer covered by the markers.

title: Layout editor for everyone

items.title: Layout editor for all accounts
items.text: Settings > Appearance > Layout is now open to everyone. You can move the sections around and change the bars and columns. Until you save a layout of your own you keep the standard one.

items.title: Chess puzzle tells you why a tap does nothing
items.text: If you tap a square that can't move, the chess puzzle now says why: the puzzle is finished, the piece isn't yours, or it has no legal moves.

title: Click a server tag to see the server

items.title: Server card on tags
items.text: Click a server tag in chat, the member list or a profile card to open a small card under it with the server's banner, icon, name, member count and tags. Press Join, or Open if you are already in the server. Move the pointer away, press Escape or click elsewhere to close it.

title: German, Russian and Chinese

items.title: Three new languages
items.text: Aduna can now be shown in German, Russian and Simplified Chinese. Pick one in Settings > Language. The choice is saved to your account, so it follows you to your other devices.

items.title: More of the app in French and Spanish
items.text: About 570 more screens and buttons are translated, including voice, calls, groups, security, the shop, payments, storage, Wordle and sign-up. A few pages are still in English, such as the admin and developer pages.

title: Translate messages

items.title: Translate messages
items.text: Settings > Language has a new Translate messages checkbox. When it is on, a message in a server channel that is written in another language shows a translation under it, in the language you picked. The text of those messages is sent to Google Translate. Direct messages and groups are encrypted, so they are never translated.

title: A new look for the wheel

items.title: New wheel
items.text: The wheel in a channel has a new look: brighter colours, a red pointer, a dark ring and a bigger centre. It spins for about four seconds. Scheduled spins work as before: you pick the time, and the winner is chosen when it comes.

title: Storage changes

items.title: Free storage limit can go lower
items.text: When many free accounts share the storage, the free limit per person can now drop to 20 MB. It used to stop at 50 MB. Below 50 MB it moves in steps of 10 MB.

items.title: Files no longer refused when shared storage is full
items.text: When the shared storage is full, new files from free accounts are kept on the server's own disk instead of being refused, as long as there is room there. Aduna Plus files always go to the main storage.

title: Advent calendar prizes

items.title: Prizes are a surprise
items.text: The doors in the Advent calendar no longer show what is behind them. Open a door to find out. It can be credits, a 1.5x credits day or a free server boost.

items.title: 1.5x credits day
items.text: A 1.5x door makes your messages and quests pay 1.5x until the end of that day (UTC). It adds to Aduna Plus and to a level 3 server. Halloween and Christmas event quests are not boosted.

items.title: Free one-day boost
items.text: A boost door gives you a free level 1 boost for 24 hours on a server you are in. Press Pick on the door to choose the server. If that server is already level 1 or higher, or you already boost it, pick another one and the prize stays waiting. A boost you never use is gone when the calendar closes on 1 January.

title: Counting towards a yearly recap

items.title: A yearly recap is coming
items.text: Aduna now keeps a count of your credits earned, quests finished, badges earned and time spent in voice channels and group calls. It only keeps numbers, never what you wrote or who you talked to. A year in review built from them is planned for January.

items.title: Friendships remember the day
items.text: Aduna now remembers the day a friend request was accepted, not just the day it was sent.

title: Try the yearly recap on the admin page

items.title: Recap tab for creators
items.text: The admin page has a new Recap tab for creator accounts. Pick a year and press Generate to see the global recap and your own, built from the data Aduna has right now. Nothing is saved or shown to anyone else.

title: Year in review in Settings

items.title: Year in review tab
items.text: Settings has a new Year in review tab. It plays a 30 second recap of your year: messages, hours in voice, credits, quests, friends and badges, plus your title and favourite hour. It appears once the recap for a year has been built, which happens in January.

items.title: Your year and everyone's
items.text: You can switch between your own recap and the one for all of Aduna. Yours uses your profile theme and your profile song, and the Aduna one uses the most popular theme and song. Only you can see yours, and it only shows numbers, never messages or names.

items.title: Sound is off until you press play
items.text: Use Pause, Replay and the mute button as it plays. Share only sends the numbers, and only when you press it.

title: Watch the test recap on the admin page

items.title: Play the recap from the Recap tab
items.text: After you press Generate, creator accounts can watch the 30 second video for their own year or for everyone, with the theme and song it would use. Nothing is saved.

items.title: No clips in the recap
items.text: The recap no longer shows a clips count, and the admin tables don't list it.

title: Recap plays your real song, in vertical

items.title: The right song
items.text: The recap now plays the 30 second preview of the song on your profile, including songs you picked from search. Before, those songs were skipped.

items.title: Vertical only
items.text: The recap video is always tall, like a phone screen. The Wide button is gone.

items.title: Bolder text
items.text: Numbers and titles in the recap are heavier and sharper.

title: Recap emoji and sharing

items.title: Emoji show up
items.text: Your most-used emoji was blank in the recap on some devices. It is now drawn as a picture, like emoji everywhere else in Aduna.

items.title: Share to friends and servers
items.text: Share in the recap opens Aduna's share sheet, so you can send your numbers to a friend or a server. More opens your device's own share menu.

title: Share the recap as a video

items.title: Recap video in chat
items.text: Share in the recap now sends the video to a friend or a server as a card with a play button. Press it to watch the 30 seconds over the chat, with the song. It is not a file and there is no link, so only the people in that chat can see it.

items.title: Reads as theirs
items.text: A recap you share from Your year says "Sam's 2026 on Aduna" for the person watching, not "Your". It still only holds numbers. Copy and More still give plain text.

title: Supporter ranks, affiliates and Clips removed

items.title: Supporter ranks
items.text: There are now three monthly ranks that show a badge next to your name: Spark, Plus and Premium. Spark pays 1.1x credits, Plus 1.5x and Premium 1.75x. Premium has everything in Plus with 20 GB of storage instead of 10 GB.

items.title: Small credit rewards add up
items.text: A message only pays a couple of credits, so the part of a bonus that does not fit in a whole credit is kept and paid with your next message.

items.title: Affiliate program
items.text: A new Affiliate page lets you send in a video about Aduna from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or Twitch and pick the name for your link. A reviewer watches it, and every approved video pays credits based on its length and how useful it is. Your first approved video makes you an affiliate.

items.title: Clips are gone
items.text: The Clips section is removed, along with its pages, the clip player and the clips switch on the server bar and in Shortcuts.

items.title: Try the recap as someone else
items.text: In /admin > Recap, creator accounts can search for a person and generate the test recap as them. Nothing is saved.

title: Creators can review their own affiliate videos

items.title: Review your own video
items.text: Creator accounts can now review the affiliate videos they sent themselves. Admins and moderators still need someone else to review theirs.

title: Easier to see affiliate badge

items.title: Darker checkmark
items.text: The checkmark on the Affiliate badge is now dark, so it is easy to see against the pastel colors, including at the small size next to a name.

title: Recap: more stats, two songs, fastest growing servers

items.title: Four stats
items.text: The recap now shows up to four stats instead of three, so credits earned and quests finished show up next to messages and voice time.

items.title: No more title
items.text: The Night Owl and Chatterbox title scene is gone from the recap.

items.title: Songs loop
items.text: If your profile song is shorter than the 30 seconds, it starts over instead of going quiet.

items.title: Two songs for everyone
items.text: The Aduna recap plays the two most popular songs and fades from the first to the second in the middle. A shared recap carries both songs.

items.title: Fastest growing servers
items.text: The Aduna recap has a new list of the three public servers that gained the most new people this year. Private servers and servers on a listing hold are left out.

items.title: Scene lengths
items.text: The intro and outro are shorter and the servers list stays on screen longer.

items.title: Admin Recap tab
items.text: The Recap tab in /admin now lists the top songs and the fastest growing servers.

title: The Aduna recap is 60 seconds

items.title: Twice as long
items.text: The recap for all of Aduna now runs 60 seconds so it can show more. Your own recap is still 30 seconds.

items.title: More to see
items.text: It shows up to six stats instead of four, and the busiest day, the busiest hour and the most-used emoji each get their own scene.

items.title: Server pictures
items.text: The fastest growing servers list now shows each server's picture, or its initials if it has none, and lists five servers instead of three.

items.title: Songs
items.text: The two songs now cross over at the 30 second mark. A shared Aduna recap can be too long to carry its songs, in which case it plays without them.

title: Supporters in the recap and new chess pieces

items.title: Our supporters
items.text: The Aduna recap has a new scene near the end that thanks the people who backed Aduna that year with Spark, Plus or Premium. Each one shows as a pill with their picture and username, highest rank first, sliding in as the list scrolls. A long list gets more time. It is only in the Aduna recap, and a shared recap leaves it out.

items.title: New chess pieces
items.text: The chess puzzle has a new set of pieces: outlined in white and filled dark grey for black. The promotion picker uses them too.

title: Pick your plan: Spark, Plus or Premium

items.title: Plan cards
items.text: The Storage window and the bottom of the Shop now show a card for each plan, with its price, what it includes and a button to get it. The plan you have is marked, with a button to manage it.

items.title: Aduna Spark
items.text: Spark is $1.99 a month in Canadian dollars ($1.49 in US dollars). It gives you a Spark badge and 1.1x credits. It has no storage of its own and none of the Plus perks.

items.title: Aduna Premium
items.text: Premium is $9.99 a month in Canadian dollars ($7.19 in US dollars). It has everything in Plus, with 20 GB of storage instead of 10 GB and 1.75x credits. Its badge shows instead of Plus or Spark if you have more than one.

items.title: Changing plans
items.text: To switch to another plan, cancel the one you have and pick the new one when it ends. Storage and Billing now work for Spark and Premium the same way they do for Plus.

title: Aduna recap songs no longer repeat

items.title: Songs play once
items.text: In the recap for all of Aduna, each song now plays once. Before, a short song started over in the middle of the cross-over and again at the end. Each song now fades out as it finishes. Your own recap still starts a short song over.
